name: token-saver
description: Saves tokens: 200k handoff warning, /warm pane of warm-cache sessions, smaller Browser screenshots, Explore nudge, deferred Browser tools

warnTokens.title: Handoff warning (tokens)
warnTokens.description: Warn when the context reaches this many tokens, then again every 100k.

exploreAfter.title: Explore nudge (calls per turn)
exploreAfter.description: After this many Read, Grep and Glob calls in one turn, suggest an Explore subagent.

shrinkScreenshots.title: Shrink Browser screenshots
shrinkScreenshots.description: Add scale 0.5 to Browser-pane screenshots and zooms that set no scale (off during visual design work).

deferBrowserTools.title: Defer Browser-pane tools
deferBrowserTools.description: List the Browser-pane tools behind ToolSearch. Takes effect in new sessions.
